# P1.12 — Outline workflow and the structured outline editor

Spec: `docs/tickets/40_P1.12__outline-workflow-and-editor.md` · run ledger: `docs/build/runs/P1.12.md`
**Stage A only** — all code + deterministic tests. Stage B (dev deploy + one real promotion
end-to-end, ≤$3) is operator-gated → **D-P1.12-1**.

## Summary

The Assistant thread becomes an author-owned Outline through one sanctioned conduit (§7.3,
REQ-CHAT-15/16/17/18, REQ-SPEC-15, REQ-DATA-23, REQ-WF-11). A new Rhema-owned skill
`outline-from-research` (declared in the port manifest's `rhemaOwned` list — the upstream pin
carries no outline skill) runs the `outline` workflow on the Assistant seat: **harvest**
(package — thread digest + the exact `urls` re-fetch; a failed fetch lands `[unverified]`,
never a drop) → **classify** (judge) → **spine** (generate — the 5–12 claim spine + the
section map + alternatives considered) → **gaps** (judge — writes `agents/author/outline/<slug>.{md,json}`
then the indefinite `approve_outline` WAIT gate). `<slug>` joins `vN`/`<run>` as a declared-path
placeholder resolved from frozen `inputs.outlineSlug`.

`outline.json` is the structured twin (registry + parser + `serializeOutline` md twin,
`<!-- rhema:outline v1 -->`): spine ids, per-section `function`/`entry`/`exit`/word budget, claim
rows whose `provenance{kind,turnId,url,notePath}` + `unverified` are DATA badges (never editable
text), alternatives, and gaps only the author can fill. Gate edits decode the same `ed.*` grammar
on both surfaces — the shared `OutlineSections` component (`@rhema/ui`) renders the
Approve-outline card AND the unlocked `/p/:slug/outline` editor (phone width read-only);
`ed.gap.<id>` Answers land `user_typed` claim rows.

Approval resolves the last-phase gate into `finalizing` (new `run.finalize` job — a
`waiting_gate` on an all-committed run no longer resumes the pod): `finalizeRun`'s outline
branch seals the head, copies the thread's source notes to `agents/author/research/` (copy,
not move; content-addressed, deduped, index merged), and emits `outline.approved{slug,…}` —
the computed `projectState` reads `outlined`. PATCH autosave lands one new version pair per
save and re-stamps provenance server-side; DELETE refuses 409 while a draft cites the outline
(frozen `inputs.outlineArtifactId`); draft run creation accepts `outlineArtifactId`.

`/outline` in chat posts the promotion sheet (scope thread/turn/research, sources-to-copy,
urls-to-refetch, `ESTIMATORS.outline` = `20 + 0.004·thread_tokens + 6·urls_refetched` estimate +
cap) — the Promote click is the consent that creates the run; nothing creates a run silently.

## Notes

- `outline` rides the **Assistant seat** (frozen in `SEAT_BY_WORKFLOW`, §7.1): it reads
  `agents/assistant/**` natively and its ONLY author-namespace grant is the declared
  `agents/author/outline/<slug>.{md,json}` pair via `declaredWritableArtifacts` +
  the `denies` exception — the outline artifact IS the conduit.
- `projects.status` stays computed (no column): approval writes the `kind:'outline'`
  artifact → `projectState` derives `outlined` → next step suggests Draft v1.
- The autosave island (`/assets/outline.js`, ~2 KB) is progressive enhancement — the no-JS
  Save button posts the identical `ed.*` form.
- Stacks on `stevevitali/p1-11-assistant-research`; merge operator-held per the chain's
  mergePolicy.
